amplicon_profile.note: The product is 46% GC, below the 70% where mixes start needing help, so nothing about its composition calls for an additive. Its richest 50 bases start at position 51 of the product and run to 52% — the richest stretch of any long product is high by construction, so read that as where to look rather than as a verdict.

primer_length_nt.below_preferred_note: Oligos shorter than 30 nt can function, but the current TwistDx manual reports typically slower amplification kinetics; no evidence-backed hard minimum is asserted here.
